name: a finished sign-in no longer checks its connection
find: if (slot !== undefined) await probeSignedInSlot({ store, now, probeCmd }, slot)
replace: if (slot === undefined) await probeSignedInSlot({ store, now, probeCmd }, slot as never)

name: the check looks for the slot by the wrong home
the card reports its end before the check is saved
a failed check leaves the card never ending
the machine stays busy while the check runs
find:
// The process is gone, so the machine is free for the next login while the check runs.
    this.clearIfCurrent(card)
